headline: Backup Report for Smith County Homes
summary: Smith County has a high outlook. It sees a long outage of 12 hours or more about once every 4 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In June 2024, 56% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 57 hours. In January 2023, 33% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 79 hours. One Core lasts about 15 hours in January. Two Cores last about 30 hours in January. Base confirms sizing at install.
